positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
TL with experience building and scaling GenAI products, customer growth and support systems, and data infrastructure at Plaid.

- Pioneered Plaid’s first personalized GenAI support chatbot, Bill+, driving X%+ ticket deflection and $XM+ in annual savings.
- Built a GenAI-powered onboarding model that increased auto-approval and reduced approval times by more than X%.
- Led a full-stack platform re-architecture that improved production-access conversion by X%.
- Bootstrapped and scaled the Growth Engineering team, partnering with Product to drive self-serve customer acquisition.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
TL with experience building and scaling growth, content, SEO, and consumer products at Airbnb.

- Scaled Online Experiences from launch to 10,000+ daily seats booked, leading full-stack growth initiatives during Airbnb’s COVID-era product pivot.
- Launched Guidebooks end to end, scaling host-generated content to tens of thousands of tips contributed per day and millions of daily guest views.
- Drove X% SEO traffic growth and X% conversion improvement through targeted landing pages, experimentation infrastructure, and SEO automation.
- Built Airbnb’s WeChat Mini Program for Experiences from concept to launch within a quarter.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: First engineer at a seed-stage fintech startup, bootstrapping the full product stack across web, iOS, Android, backend, data, and payments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer with experience in Ads across Facebook and Instagram.

- Launched Saved Audience, driving 25% adoption within three months and expanding the targeting-reuse experience across Ads Manager surfaces.
- Redesigned Custom Audience infrastructure and launched a higher-performance Audience Manager, alongside tooling and monitoring to detect and mitigate malicious use.
- Built Instagram’s initial iOS advertising experience, including direct-response ads, an in-app browser, and video ad improvements.
